title: [FEATURE] Add support for Github Copilot SDK
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

Requirement: A lot of users (including enterprise users) have existing subscription to Github Copilot which gives them access to various AI models including claude. Adding support for Copilot within Claude code would let users use their existing subscriptions within the tool.

### Proposed Solution

Integrate the newly launched Copilot SDK to Claude code : [copilot-sdk](https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/tree/main)

top_comments.body:
@pranjalsinha99 @HeegonJin you don't need to wait on first-party SDK support for this - there's a way today that does exactly what you're after: use your Copilot sub (incl. its Claude models) inside Claude Code, no separate Anthropic key.

I maintain a fork that's a local proxy exposing Copilot as a native Anthropic endpoint. point Claude Code at it:

```
npx copilot-api-node20@latest start
```

then set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4141` (+ any non-empty `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) and run cla
